summary: Iteration 4 frontend-only test of Bronze Blitz new features: diagonal swap, new match formations, special+special combos, Blitz Finale, culture facts, formation guide, new trophies, and regression. 15/15 engine unit tests pass (diag line of 3/4 -> run detected, 2x2 square -> X-Blaster 'x', plus -> 'cross', L -> 'bomb', 2x3 -> 'nova', line 5 -> 'disco', bomb+bomb -> 5x5 clear, nova+any -> 7x7, disco+special yields effects, isDiagonal correct). UI: formation-guide + 6 cards (col, x, cross, bomb, nova, disco) render on hub. All 4 new trophy cards (diagonal, xblaster, crown_cross, supernova) render on /trophies. Classic Level 1 completed via hinted plays: Blitz Finale banner + skip button appeared, skip-btn resolved to result-modal in 0.80s, culture-fact + culture-fact-text visible with non-empty Fact, 'Blitz Finale +6,750 from leftover moves' text displayed. Zen cash-out also shows result-modal with culture-fact. Diagonal hints suggested diagonally adjacent tiles (e.g. [0-3, 1-4]) and tapping both executed a diagonal swap. Viewports 320x568, 375x667, 390x844 all show play screen without scroll overflow (docHeight == windowHeight). Regression PASS: with correctly formatted treesh_stars={points:750} + treesh_accent + treesh_profile, nav shows avatar img, starlites badge '950' (includes 200 welcome gift), --ac=#10B981. No console/page errors during gameplay or UI nav. combo-word popup is centered within 390px viewport.
action_items: Defensive-only (non-blocking): /app/frontend/src/game/wallet.js changeStarlites() does `const st = readJson(STARS_KEY) || {};` then `st.points = ...`. If an external integrator writes treesh_stars as a bare number (e.g. localStorage.setItem('treesh_stars','750')), JSON.parse returns 750 and assigning .points throws 'Cannot create property points on number 750', surfacing the Emergent runtime-error overlay. Reproduced in this run. Suggest: `let st = readJson(STARS_KEY); if (!st || typeof st !== 'object') st = {};`
critical_code_review_comments: engine.resolveMatches: 2x2 square without a group-of-6 produces 'x' special (good). However when a square overlaps a 3-run of same type, the run is still processed and may double-create specials at adjacent cells; current `taken` set only guards within one place() call. Edge case worth a visual check during cascades.

useGame.runFinale: setBoard(nb) is called inside a tight while loop with 150ms wait; if the user clicks finale-skip-btn, skipRef flips but the loop still iterates until moves hits 0 (fast because wait() returns immediately when skip). Confirmed skip resolves in ~0.8s. OK.
wallet.changeStarlites not defensive against non-object treesh_stars value (see action item).
ResultModal.CultureFact animates in at delay:0.7s; if an automation screenshots at modal-open it may miss the fact visually though DOM content is present. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional; 1 minor defensive issue in wallet.changeStarlites
